feeds.description: Feeds available to source data from.

^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$.description: The key of this object is used to identify the feed in the API. It should be short and unique.

name.description: The name of the feed. This will be shown to end users.

description.description: A description of the feed. This will be shown to end users.
examples: All transit agencies in the Puget Sound region

serviceArea.description:
An optional override to the feed's service area polygon. If not provided, the service area will be derived from the locations of stops provided by the feed.

This should be in the same format as the "coordinates" property of a GeoJSON Polygon.

gtfs.description: Configuration parameters for a GTFS feed.

quirks.description: Optional list of GTFS quirks to apply when processing this feed. Quirks are workarounds for ad-hoc issues found in GTFS feeds.

fuzzyMatchTripUpdates.description: If enabled, GTFS-RT trip updates will be matched using a substring of `trip_id` rather than an exact match.

propagateBlockDelays.description: If enabled, a trip with no realtime data of its own may inherit a delay from the preceding trip on the same block - the same vehicle earlier in its rotation. The carried delay is reduced by the scheduled layover, and such predictions are reported with a predictionSource of "block". Requires block_id in the feed.

static.description: Where to fetch the static GTFS zip file from.

rtTripUpdates.description:
Optional reference to a GTFS-RT Trip Updates feed. Will supply real-time data if available.

Multiple may be specified, in which case their results will be merged.

routeIds.description: If specified, this GTFS-RT feed will only be requested for these route IDs. This is useful if multiple GTFS-RT feeds are specified and each only covers a subset of routes.

onebusaway.description: Configuration parameters for a OneBusAway feed.

baseUrl.description: Base URL to the OneBusAway instance to use.

timeout.description: Number of milliseconds to wait before timing out a request to the OneBusAway API. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds).

enabled.description: Whether to enable rate limiting for this feed. Defaults to true.

tokensPerInterval.description: Number of tokens to add to the bucket per interval. Each request will remove 1 token from the bucket. Defaults to 1.

interval.description: Length of each interval in milliseconds. Defaults to 200ms.

excludeAgencyIds.description: A list of OneBusAway agency IDs to exclude from this feed. Stops and routes belonging to these agencies will not appear in stop listings, route listings, or schedules. Defaults to an empty array (no agencies excluded).

hafas.description: Configuration parameters for a HAFAS feed.

profile.description: A preset HAFAS profile to use for `hafas-client`. See: https://github.com/public-transport/hafas-client/blob/main/p/readme.md#built-in-profiles

userAgent.description: A string containing your project name and contact information.

mvg.description: Configuration parameters for an MVG (Munich Public Transit) feed.

baseUrl.description: Base URL to the MVG API. Defaults to https://www.mvg.de/api/bgw-pt/v3

headers.description: Optional headers to send with the request. Useful if authorization is required.

oneOf.description: Shorthand for specifying a URL. If a string is provided where an HttpRequestOptions object is expected, it will be interpreted as the URL with no additional headers.

FeedAuth.description: Authentication for this request. Discriminated on `provider`. Use a YAML anchor to declare it once and reference it from both `static` and `rtTripUpdates`.

NjTransitAuth.description: NJ TRANSIT's GTFS/GTFS-RT API, which requires a session token obtained by logging in. Register at https://developer.njtransit.com/registration. Note that NJ TRANSIT limits token issuance to 10 calls per account per day and exceeding it locks the account out until midnight Eastern.

api.description: Which endpoint family to use. Rail and bus are separate APIs on different hosts, with separate accounts and separate daily token budgets.

baseUrl.description: Overrides the built-in base URL. Intended for tests and staging.

usernameFile.description: Path to a file containing the username. Relative paths resolve against $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY when systemd has set it.

passwordFile.description: Path to a file containing the password. Relative paths resolve against $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY when systemd has set it.

dailyTokenBudget.description: Maximum login calls per Eastern day. NJ TRANSIT's own hard limit is 10; the default leaves headroom for manual debugging against the same account.

tokenMaxAge.description: Re-authenticate once the cached token is older than this, as a duration string such as '20h' or a number of milliseconds.
